response.justification: Bogdan brings a long and varied engineering track record (roughly 15 years of professional work since 2009, longer if freelance is counted) with genuine breadth across web, backend, mobile, embedded, and low-latency systems, plus founder experience with an open-source geo-data platform and a visible community-teaching presence. However, the role targets a Director-level individual contributor with recognized AI expertise, cloud platform strategy depth, and a record of advising strategic customers and shaping product direction — none of which is evidenced here. AI exposure is limited to recent MCP/agent tooling work at re:cinq rather than building or productizing ML/AI platforms, and there is no cloud-architecture leadership at scale (AWS CDK usage aside) or executive-level influence work. The profile reads as a strong senior/staff hands-on engineer rather than a principal-level AI strategy hire.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, embedded, low-latency, and infrastructure work
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective) with real users and Kubernetes deployment
Strong craftsmanship and knowledge-sharing record: TDD, CI/CD, conference talks, workshops, OSS libraries
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI products/platforms shipped; agent tooling exposure is recent and narrow
Limited cloud platform strategy or architecture leadership; no evidence of advising strategic customers/partners
Career trajectory is senior/staff IC rather than director-level; no advanced degree in an AI field

key_factors.factor: AI expertise and demonstrated AI products
Breadth of engineering experience and entrepreneurial/OSS founder background
